localChange: Nine bug fixes and five practice features

results.name: Startup: notation, 94 presets, simulated MIDI, assets
All presets render valid note coordinates
All 96 supported meter/bar/subdivision combinations render
Keyboard: all 13 instruments, normal/accent/ghost
Keyboard shortcuts do not trigger when editing text
Tempo UI enforces 30-260 BPM and keyboard increments
BUG: editor clicks follow normal -> accent -> ghost -> empty
Editor modifiers, erase, resize and copy first bar
Save, duplicate, export and reload preserve an edited rhythm
JSON upload accepts valid patterns and rejects malformed JSON
BUG: imported non-string sticking must not crash pattern loading
BUG: imported non-string name must not break export
BUG: corrupted library shape must recover on startup
MIDI learn, input, choke, pedal and reset through UI
MIDI unsupported: keyboard fallback still works
MIDI denied: keyboard fallback still works
MIDI empty: keyboard fallback still works
MIDI hot-plug updates connection status
Scheduler: metronome subdivisions, quiet bars and MIDI output
Single pass automatically stops and counts all 12 missed notes
BUG: completed single pass is shown in pass history
BUG: count-in strikes do not reduce exercise accuracy
Recording quantizes live hits and preserves dynamic accents
Trainer increases tempo for 90%+ pass and clamps maximum
BUG: concurrent Start requests create only one playback timer
BUG: all 19 instruments produce non-silent synthesized audio
Desktop and tablet layouts fit viewport without document overflow
Phone layout at 390px fits viewport
Narrow phone layout at 360px fits viewport
Calibration estimates latency and rejects insufficient hits
WAV sample kit loads and missing kit falls back to synth
BUG: failed persistent save must not report success
Continuous playback completes eight loops without growing pending queue
Feature: A-B scores only chosen bars and instruments while retaining other raw hits
Feature: empty instrument selection prevents starting with an explanation
Feature: weak segment suggestion uses the last session and lowers tempo
Feature: journal stores session, statistics and completed passes across reload
Feature: original MIDI zone, velocity and fractional timing survive capture and reload
Feature: journal compares matching sessions and reports the best 90-percent BPM
Feature: failed journal save retains the performance and retry persists it
Feature: replay renders expected notes, real hits and misses without quantization
Feature: replay slows original timing, pauses, seeks and stops independently
Feature: MIDI and JSON exports retain recorded notes and velocity
Feature: backing WAV, A-B, first beat and half-speed share the audio clock
Feature: backing starts after count-in and repeats selected audio segment
Feature: invalid backing file and out-of-file loop fail without starting playback
Feature: program persists snapshots, runs sequentially and stores both outcomes
Feature: stopping a program during its break cancels the next exercise
Feature: canceling pending audio initialization cannot start a stale session
Feature: all five studio panels fit desktop, tablet and phone widths
Feature: Space operates focused controls without unexpectedly starting a session
Feature: corrupt journal fields remain readable and safe after reload
Feature: backing volume changes live and speed choices respect tempo limits
